duckdb_v2.h and duckdb_extension_v2.h are vendored byte for byte from
src/include/ in the DuckDB source repository (github.com/duckdb/duckdb).

tag:    v2.0.0

Refresh with `git show <tag>:src/include/<file>`, then run
scripts/regenerate_v2_bindings.sh and commit the new bindings.rs with them.
